input.rationale: The Agreement has no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless provision anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) contains only mutual corporate authority representations and the Globix carve-out, and Section 10 (General Provisions) has no indemnity; searches for indemnify/hold harmless/infringement/claims return only the advertising-content covenant in Section 7.2. HDI therefore gives the Company no protection against third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site it designs, hosts and operates, which is walk-away territory under INDEMN. We insert an HDI IP indemnity at the fallback level (customary Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a three-times-annual-fees super-cap) immediately after the warranty section; the broader preferred indemnity (breach of law, HDI-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct plus defence procedure) remains our preference if negotiable.

proposal.summary: Insert HDI IP indemnity with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's third-party IP infringement indemnity for the Site and its services, with the customary Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, the procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a cap of three times annual fees. This is our fallback position; we would prefer a broader indemnity also covering HDI's breach of law, data breaches and wilful misconduct.

ops.text: Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall indemnify the Company against any third-party claim alleging that the Site or the services provided by HDI under this Agreement infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from modifications made by the Company, combination of the Site with items not supplied by HDI, or the Company's specifications or Content. HDI shall procure for the Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, HDI shall refund the fees paid by the Company for the affected item. HDI's total liability under this Section 9.1 shall not exceed three (3) times the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
